name: CanCollectList
rows:
A fantastic night comes at the cost of a rough morning.
This is for your refreshing morning.
Adios, hangover.

Stubborn belly fat? Get rid of it with a drink now!
A weight loss drink for a slim waist!
Hyper Tube!
A sip of salvation for the lonely crow.

The electrifying thrill that zaps away stress and worries —
the miraculous 0 kcal.

No forks and plates needed.
All you need to do is drink.
Beverages are the best desserts.

A refreshing sensation that washes away the fatigue of everyday life.
An oasis that quenches the dryness of your daily routine.

The eternal ruler of delightful nights.
Too bad there's no place for you here.
Hangover, you lose.

The softness of jelly that melts on your tongue.
Swallow the jelly.
Fusion Jell.
Clock tower, left side, goddess statue

It's a quiet day.
The breeze feels lovely.
How about a cup of tea today?

I thought I was only getting the smoothness of milk tea, but the chewy pearls surprised me at the last sip.
Ah, it turns out you're both smooth and chewy!

To the tasteful you —
The peony, sovereign of all blooms.

90% refreshing apple juice!
An apple? Why bother biting into one?
An Adam's apple is all the apple you'll ever need!

Wishing you a restful night.
Good evening.

*Zap zap*
Like a shock straight to your taste buds!
Electric Boom!
Note: Do not drink if you have mouth injuries.

This is a military beverage supplied by the Central Government.
Commercial sale is strictly prohibited.
Violators will be subject to severe penalties.

No impurities allowed.
The purest water in the world.

Strike back against the boring daily grind!
C'mon, let's head into a new life!

Under a blanket of stars, with friends by my side.
Reminiscing about those cherished days in the stillness of night.

May you raise a glass with your comrades
on the day when the Goddess of Victory smiles.
